description: This source file implements a function to convert 16-bit floating point (half-precision) values to 32-bit floating point (single-precision) values, using precomputed lookup tables for mantissa, exponent, and offset. It is part of the ANGLE project, specifically within the common math utilities.

methods.name: float16ToFloat32
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit half-precision float to a 32-bit float using lookup tables and bit casting.
